labels.variantDefinition: A uniform grid of cells mixing large glyphs, sample sentences, dates and notes like a specimen sheet, often with controls for grid divisions or style
labels.look: Black cells with thin white rules: big typewriter glyphs (*, 2, r, k, 3), French pangrams, '1873-2018', small italic notes
labels.ux: Header range slider sets the number of grid divisions (1-6); style menu (Light, Italic, Roman…); colour-mode toggle
labels.learn: Let the visitor set the grid density: the same content flips between glyph close-ups and a dense specimen sheet

labels.variantDefinition: The visitor restyles single words in the sample (weight, italic angle, spacing, features) by hovering or selecting them and using mouse or keyboard gestures
labels.look: Grey, large multilingual paragraph (Latin, Cyrillic, dingbats), left rail of feature icons, Reset/Set buttons; privacy modal covers the top in the capture
labels.ux: Hover a word, move mouse for weight, hold right for italic angle, spacebar for letter-spacing; feature toggles; type-your-own field
labels.learn: Style per word instead of per block: a single paragraph can show many styles at once, like a designer's mix

labels.look: Flat violet, five centred lines 'Fictional Light' to 'Fictional UltraBold', each in its own weight, slightly rotated
labels.ux: Each style name is a button carrying its weight value (likely sets the specimen weight)
labels.learn: A stacked list of style names set in themselves is the cheapest family overview there is, and still reads as a specimen

labels.variantDefinition: Large glyphs tumbled or scattered across the field, overlapping, as a graphic texture rather than an ordered set
labels.look: White, huge black serif lowercase and caps tossed at angles and overlapping, cut by a black nav bar
labels.ux: Static image that fades in; arrow navigation in the sticky bar
labels.learn: Treat letters as objects thrown onto a table: angles and overlaps reveal shapes that an aligned line hides

labels.variantDefinition: One word at a time is typed, erased and replaced in a loop (typewriter effect), each word chosen to show off alternates or styles
labels.look: Two lilac panels on purple: 'QWERTY_' typed with a caret on the left, grey canvas photo of a computer lab with Get / Type tester links on the right
labels.ux: Auto-typing word cycle with stylistic sets on; canvas image reacts to the pointer; links to buy and tester
labels.learn: Typing the words out letter by letter makes the eye catch each alternate as it appears

labels.look: Book-spread layout: red bold italic 'Drink me' with colour dots and controls left, grid of 'a' interpolating outline to pink right, 'Weight axis' caption
labels.ux: Weight slider, Roman/Italic, size XS-XL and colour swatches restyle 'Drink me' live
labels.learn: Frame the page as a book spread: the tester sits on the left page, the explanation on the right

labels.variantDefinition: A tool that tiles ornament or dingbat glyphs into a pattern from typed text, with presets, grid size and symmetry options
labels.look: White, on-screen keyboard of red leaf ornaments, monospace 'Pattern text' box, presets 1-12, and a large red tiled border pattern
labels.ux: Type or click keys to compose pattern text; set grid X/Y, canvas and pattern symmetry; copy plain text
labels.learn: For an ornament font, ship a pattern maker: it shows the glyphs tile and hands users the exact text to paste

labels.look: Violet-tinted spice photo, swash capitals A-Z in yellow and white scattered and overlapping, yellow 'Cherry on the cake' sticky bar
labels.ux: static; sticky section bar with cart
labels.learn: Name the swash set 'Cherry on the cake' within the cooking metaphor: the alternates read as the finishing touch

labels.look: White, 'NEWS' label, large black condensed serif headline 'Food as Resistance at La Morada', italic dek, byline
labels.ux: Article teaser linking to the full story
labels.learn: A real headline, dek and byline shows the hierarchy a family can carry in four lines
